<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Lora:ital,wght@0,400;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68108c29063eeb5d1bd7ae4a/6a68c28696192b91c48d1768_dealality-old-home-dark.v20260728ag.css">
<style>
html,body,#dc-page{background:#080F25!important;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;margin:0;padding:0}
#nav-logo img,.oh-nav-logo-img{display:block!important;width:148px!important;height:auto!important;max-width:148px!important;max-height:36px!important;object-fit:contain!important;object-position:left center!important}
#hero,#hero-inner,.oh-hero,.oh-hero-inner{overflow:visible!important}
#hero-inner,.oh-hero-inner{max-width:1100px!important;width:100%!important}
#hero-lead,.oh-hero-lead{overflow:visible!important;white-space:normal!important;max-width:42rem!important;width:100%!important}
#h1wrap,.oh-h1wrap{display:flex!important;flex-direction:row!important;flex-wrap:nowrap!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;width:100%!important;overflow:visible!important;gap:.32em!important;--hr-lh:clamp(32px,4vw,56px);--hr-slots:5}
#hstatic,.oh-hstatic{flex-shrink:0!important;white-space:nowrap!important;z-index:2;position:relative}
#hrwrap,.oh-hrwrap{display:block!important;overflow:hidden!important;height:calc(var(--hr-lh)*var(--hr-slots))!important;width:var(--hr-w,560px)!important;min-width:min(560px,100%)!important;max-width:none!important;contain:none!important;position:relative!important;z-index:1;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0%,#000 14%,#000 86%,transparent 100%);mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0%,#000 14%,#000 86%,transparent 100%)}
#rotator,.oh-rotator{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;width:max-content;min-width:100%}
#rotator>*{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;height:var(--hr-lh)!important;min-height:var(--hr-lh)!important;max-height:var(--hr-lh)!important;line-height:var(--hr-lh)!important;white-space:nowrap!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;opacity:.08;color:#8B90FF;font-family:Lora,Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(26px,3.6vw,48px)}
#rotator>*.near{opacity:.28}
#rotator>*.far{opacity:.14}
#rotator>*.on,#rotator>*.oh-hrword-on{opacity:1!important;color:#D78E2C!important;font-family:Inter Tight,Plus Jakarta Sans,system-ui,sans-serif!important;font-style:normal!important;font-weight:800!important;letter-spacing:-.035em}
@media(max-width:960px){#h1wrap,.oh-h1wrap{flex-direction:column!important;--hr-slots:3;--hr-lh:clamp(28px,7vw,44px)}#hrwrap,.oh-hrwrap{min-width:0!important;width:var(--hr-w,100%)!important;max-width:100%!important}#rotator>*{justify-content:center}}
/* Varko-style Section Sub Title */
#section-subtitle,.oh-sst-wrap{display:flex!important;justify-content:center!important;align-items:center!important;width:100%!important;margin:0 0 1rem!important;text-align:center!important}
#sst-inner,.oh-sst-inner{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:flex-start!important;position:relative!important;overflow:hidden!important;z-index:1!important;padding:5px 15px 5px 5px!important;border-radius:12px!important}
#sst-pill,.oh-sst-pill{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;background:#343259!important;color:#fff!important;font-weight:500!important;font-size:16px!important;line-height:32px!important;padding:0 10px!important;border-radius:10px!important;white-space:nowrap!important;position:relative!important;z-index:2!important;text-transform:capitalize!important}
#sst-text,.oh-sst-text{color:#fff!important;font-weight:500!important;font-size:16px!important;line-height:1.4!important;margin-left:15px!important;text-transform:capitalize!important;white-space:nowrap!important;position:relative!important;z-index:2!important}
#sst-glow,.oh-sst-glow{position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;z-index:0!important;overflow:hidden!important;border-radius:12px!important;pointer-events:none!important}
#sst-bg1,.oh-sst-bg1{position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;border-radius:12px!important;background:#1a1a21!important;z-index:0!important}
#sst-bg2,.oh-sst-bg2{position:absolute!important;inset:1px!important;z-index:1!important;border-radius:11px!important;background:#0f0f15!important}
#sst-rotate,.oh-sst-rotate{position:absolute!important;z-index:0!important;width:20vw!important;height:20vw!important;left:50%!important;top:50%!important;margin:0!important;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)!important;animation:oh-sst-spin 4s linear infinite!important}
#sst-rotate-inner,.oh-sst-rotate-inner{position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;background:conic-gradient(from 0deg,transparent 0deg,#8B90FF 28deg,#6C72FF 55deg,transparent 95deg)!important;-webkit-filter:blur(8px)!important;filter:blur(8px)!important}
@keyframes oh-sst-spin{0%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(0)}100%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(360deg)}}
@media(max-width:640px){#sst-text,.oh-sst-text{font-size:14px!important;margin-left:10px!important}#sst-pill,.oh-sst-pill{font-size:14px!important;line-height:28px!important}}
/* Varko-style Form Subscribe Wrap */
#hero-ctas,.oh-hero-ctas-hidden{display:none!important}
#form-subscribe-wrap,.oh-fsw-wrap{position:relative!important;z-index:1!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;width:100%!important;margin:.35rem 0 1.5rem!important}
#fsw-shell,.oh-fsw-form{position:relative!important;z-index:2!important;display:inline-flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:center!important;max-width:630px!important;width:min(630px,100%)!important;margin:0!important}
#fsw-shell .w-form,#fsw-shell form,#fsw-inner,.oh-fsw-inner{position:relative!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;max-width:630px!important;margin:0!important}
#fsw-field-wrap,.oh-fsw-field-wrap{position:relative!important;overflow:hidden!important;flex:1!important;width:100%!important;border-radius:12px!important}
#fsw-email{position:relative!important;z-index:2!important;display:block!important;width:100%!important;height:60px!important;margin:0!important;padding:0 158px 0 20px!important;border:0!important;outline:none!important;box-shadow:none!important;background:transparent!important;color:#fff!important;font-family:Inter Tight,Plus Jakarta Sans,system-ui,sans-serif!important;font-size:16px!important;font-weight:400!important;line-height:60px!important;-webkit-appearance:none!important;appearance:none!important}
#fsw-email::placeholder{color:#ffffff8a!important;opacity:1!important}
#fsw-email:focus{color:#fff!important}
#fsw-glow{position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;z-index:0!important;overflow:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important;border-radius:12px!important}
#fsw-bg1{position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;z-index:0!important;border-radius:12px!important;background:#171719!important}
#fsw-bg2{position:absolute!important;inset:1px!important;z-index:1!important;border-radius:11px!important;background:#08080e!important;background-image:linear-gradient(#0c0b12,#08080e)!important}
#fsw-glow-rotate{position:absolute!important;z-index:0!important;width:110%!important;height:200%!important;margin:auto!important;inset:0 5% 0 -5%!important;background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 35%,#b7a2fc 50%,transparent 65%)!important;transform-origin:center center!important;animation:oh-fsw-spin 4s linear infinite!important}
#fsw-btn-wrap,.oh-fsw-btn-wrap{position:absolute!important;z-index:3!important;inset:5px 5px 5px auto!important;display:inline-flex!important;align-items:stretch!important}
#fsw-submit-hit{position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;z-index:99!important;width:100%!important;height:50px!important;opacity:0!important;border:0!important;background:transparent!important;cursor:pointer!important;overflow:visible!important}
#fsw-btn{position:relative!important;z-index:1!important;display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;overflow:hidden!important;border-radius:12px!important;color:#fff!important;text-decoration:none!important;font-family:Inter Tight,Plus Jakarta Sans,system-ui,sans-serif!important;font-weight:500!important;font-size:16px!important;line-height:50px!important;padding:0 22px!important;white-space:nowrap!important;background:transparent!important}
#fsw-btn-text{position:relative!important;z-index:2!important;color:#fff!important}
#fsw-btn-grad{position:absolute!important;z-index:0!important;inset:0 0 0 -100%!important;width:200%!important;height:100%!important;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#b7a2fc,#6d5cd8 50%,#b7a2fc)!important;animation:oh-fsw-grad 2.8s linear infinite!important}
#fsw-btn:hover #fsw-btn-grad{filter:brightness(1.08)}
#fsw-grid{position:absolute!important;z-index:-1!important;width:300px!important;height:150px!important;margin:auto!important;left:50%!important;top:-10px!important;transform:translateX(-50%)!important;pointer-events:none!important}
#fsw-grid>*{position:absolute!important;background:#ffffff0d!important}
#fsw-grid>:nth-child(1){width:300px;height:1px;inset:0 0 auto 0}
#fsw-grid>:nth-child(2){width:300px;height:1px;inset:auto 0 0 0}
#fsw-grid>:nth-child(3){width:1px;height:150px;inset:0 auto auto 0}
#fsw-grid>:nth-child(4){width:1px;height:150px;inset:0 auto auto 16.67%}
#fsw-grid>:nth-child(5){width:1px;height:150px;inset:0 auto auto 33.33%}
#fsw-grid>:nth-child(6){width:1px;height:150px;inset:0 auto auto 50%}
#fsw-grid>:nth-child(7){width:1px;height:150px;inset:0 auto auto 66.67%}
#fsw-grid>:nth-child(8){width:1px;height:150px;inset:0 auto auto 83.33%}
#fsw-grid>:nth-child(9){width:1px;height:150px;inset:0 auto auto 100%}
#fsw-secondary-wrap{margin:16px 0 0!important;text-align:center!important;color:#9aa3b8!important;font-size:14px!important}
#fsw-secondary{color:#c5cae8!important;text-decoration:none!important;font-weight:500!important}
#fsw-secondary:hover{color:#fff!important}
#form-subscribe-wrap .w-form-done,#form-subscribe-wrap .w-form-fail{display:none!important}
@keyframes oh-fsw-spin{0%{transform:rotate(0)}100%{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes oh-fsw-grad{0%{transform:translateX(0)}100%{transform:translateX(50%)}}
@media(max-width:700px){#fsw-shell,.oh-fsw-form{width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important}#fsw-email{padding-right:140px!important;font-size:15px!important;height:56px!important;line-height:56px!important}#fsw-btn{padding:0 16px!important;line-height:46px!important;font-size:15px!important}#fsw-submit-hit{height:46px!important}#fsw-grid{display:none!important}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#fsw-glow-rotate,#fsw-btn-grad{animation:none!important}}
/* FAQ: soft line + theme blue center glow only */
#faq-1-div,#faq-2-div,#faq-3-div,#faq-4-div,#faq-5-div,#faq-6-div,#faq-7-div,#faq-8-div,#faq-9-div,#faq-10-div,.oh-faq-div{background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.28) 50%,transparent)!important}
#faq-1-glow,#faq-2-glow,#faq-3-glow,#faq-4-glow,#faq-5-glow,#faq-6-glow,#faq-7-glow,#faq-8-glow,#faq-9-glow,#faq-10-glow,.oh-faq-line-glow{background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#6C72FF 50%,transparent)!important}
/* Insights dividers: soft fade + theme blue center glow */
#ins-1::after,#ins-2::after,#ins-3::after,#ins-4::after,#ins-5::after,.oh-ins-card:not(:last-child)::after{content:""!important;position:absolute!important;top:3%!important;bottom:3%!important;right:calc(var(--ins-gap,2rem)/-2)!important;width:1px!important;background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.28) 50%,transparent)!important;opacity:1!important;pointer-events:none!important;z-index:2!important;display:block!important}
#ins-1::before,#ins-2::before,#ins-3::before,#ins-4::before,#ins-5::before,.oh-ins-card:not(:last-child)::before{content:""!important;position:absolute!important;top:50%!important;right:calc(var(--ins-gap,2rem)/-2)!important;width:4px!important;height:90px!important;transform:translate(50%,-50%)!important;border-radius:70px!important;background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#6C72FF 50%,transparent)!important;filter:blur(1.5px)!important;pointer-events:none!important;z-index:3!important;display:block!important}
#cta-band-inner,.oh-cta-band-inner{max-width:1320px!important;width:100%!important;margin-left:auto!important;margin-right:auto!important}
#ins-1-date,#ins-2-date,#ins-3-date,#ins-4-date,#ins-5-date,#ins-6-date,.oh-ins-date{color:#9b8fc9!important}
#cta-band-h2,.oh-cta-band-h2{font-family:"Plus Jakarta Sans","Inter Tight",system-ui,sans-serif!important;font-size:clamp(26px,3.5vw,44px)!important;font-weight:800!important;line-height:1.15!important;letter-spacing:-.03em!important;color:#fff!important;max-width:min(54rem,100%)!important;margin-bottom:18px!important;text-transform:none!important;white-space:normal!important}
#cta-band-lead,.oh-cta-band-lead{font-family:"Inter Tight","Plus Jakarta Sans",system-ui,sans-serif!important;font-size:1.05rem!important;font-weight:400!important;line-height:1.55!important;color:rgba(255,255,255,.68)!important;max-width:42rem!important;text-align:center!important;white-space:pre-line!important}
#cta-band-badges,.oh-cta-band-badges{position:relative!important;z-index:1!important;display:flex!important;justify-content:center!important;margin:0 0 14px!important}
#cta-band-badge,.oh-cta-band-badge{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;overflow:hidden!important;border-radius:999px!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14)!important;background:rgba(8,15,37,.92)!important;padding:5px 15px 5px 5px!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(109,92,216,.1),0 0 28px rgba(109,92,216,.18)!important}
#cta-band-badge-left,.oh-cta-band-badge-left{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;padding:0 10px!important;height:32px!important;border-radius:10px!important;background:#343259!important;color:#fff!important;font-size:1rem!important;font-weight:500!important;line-height:1!important;text-transform:capitalize!important;white-space:nowrap!important}
#cta-band-badge-right,.oh-cta-band-badge-right{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;margin-left:15px!important;color:#fff!important;font-size:1rem!important;font-weight:500!important;line-height:1!important;text-transform:capitalize!important;white-space:nowrap!important}
#cta-band-card,.oh-cta-band-card{padding:clamp(4rem,7.5vw,6rem) clamp(1.5rem,5vw,4rem)!important}
#cta-band-badges,.oh-cta-band-badges{margin:0 0 28px!important}
#cta-band-h2,.oh-cta-band-h2{margin:0 auto 24px!important;max-width:min(44rem,100%)!important;line-height:1.18!important}
#cta-band-lead,.oh-cta-band-lead{margin:0 auto 2.75rem!important;max-width:36rem!important;line-height:1.65!important;white-space:pre-line!important}
#cta-band-note,.oh-cta-band-note{position:relative!important;z-index:1!important;margin:.9rem 0 0!important;font-size:.88rem!important;font-weight:400!important;line-height:1.4!important;color:rgba(255,255,255,.38)!important;text-align:center!important}
#cta-band-h2-accent,.oh-cta-band-h2-accent,.oh-cta-band-h2-accent-1{color:#D78E2C!important}
/* Insights carousel — exactly 3 wide on desktop; 6 cards scroll */
#insights-inner,.oh-insights-inner{min-width:0!important;max-width:1320px!important;width:100%!important;box-sizing:border-box!important}
#insights-carousel,.oh-insights-carousel{min-width:0!important;max-width:100%!important;width:100%!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important}
#insights-grid,.oh-insights-grid{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:nowrap!important;overflow-x:auto!important;overflow-y:hidden!important;width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch!important}
#insights-grid,.oh-insights-grid{--ins-gap:2rem!important;--ins-visible:3!important;gap:var(--ins-gap)!important;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory!important}
#ins-1,#ins-2,#ins-3,#ins-4,#ins-5,#ins-6,.oh-ins-card{--ins-card-w:calc((100% - (var(--ins-gap) * (var(--ins-visible) - 1))) / var(--ins-visible));flex:0 0 var(--ins-card-w)!important;flex-shrink:0!important;width:var(--ins-card-w)!important;min-width:var(--ins-card-w)!important;max-width:var(--ins-card-w)!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;scroll-snap-align:start!important}
@media(max-width:960px){#insights-grid,.oh-insights-grid{--ins-visible:2!important;--ins-gap:1.25rem!important}}
@media(max-width:640px){#insights-grid,.oh-insights-grid{--ins-visible:1!important;--ins-gap:1rem!important}}
#insights-prev.is-disabled,#insights-next.is-disabled,#insights-prev[aria-disabled="true"],#insights-next[aria-disabled="true"]{pointer-events:auto!important}

#faq-1-body p+p,#faq-2-body p+p,#faq-3-body p+p,#faq-4-body p+p,#faq-5-body p+p,#faq-6-body p+p,#faq-7-body p+p,#faq-8-body p+p,#faq-9-body p+p,#faq-10-body p+p,#faq-11-body p+p,.oh-faq-body p+p{margin-top:.85rem!important}
#faq-1-body ul,#faq-2-body ul,#faq-3-body ul,#faq-4-body ul,#faq-5-body ul,#faq-6-body ul,#faq-7-body ul,#faq-8-body ul,#faq-9-body ul,#faq-10-body ul,#faq-11-body ul,.oh-faq-body ul{margin:.75rem 0 0!important;padding:0 0 0 1.15rem!important;color:rgba(255,255,255,.76)!important}
#faq-1-body li,#faq-2-body li,#faq-3-body li,#faq-4-body li,#faq-5-body li,#faq-6-body li,#faq-7-body li,#faq-8-body li,#faq-9-body li,#faq-10-body li,#faq-11-body li,.oh-faq-body li{margin:.35rem 0!important;font-size:1rem!important;line-height:1.55!important;color:rgba(255,255,255,.76)!important}
#faq-8,#faq-9,#faq-10,#faq-11,.oh-faq-item{display:block!important}
#faq-8-sum,#faq-9-sum,#faq-10-sum,#faq-11-sum,.oh-faq-sum{position:relative!important;display:block!important;cursor:pointer!important;list-style:none!important;padding:0 40px 0 0!important;color:#fff!important}
#faq-8-q,#faq-9-q,#faq-10-q,#faq-11-q,.oh-faq-q{display:inline-block!important;font-family:Inter Tight,system-ui,sans-serif!important;font-size:clamp(1.15rem,1rem + .6vw,1.5rem)!important;font-weight:500!important;line-height:1.55!important;color:#fff!important}
#faq-8-chev,#faq-9-chev,#faq-10-chev,#faq-11-chev,.oh-faq-chev{position:absolute!important;right:0!important;top:.55em!important;width:20px!important;height:20px!important;display:block!important}
#faq-8-chev::before,#faq-9-chev::before,#faq-10-chev::before,#faq-11-chev::before,.oh-faq-chev::before{content:""!important;position:absolute!important;left:6px!important;top:4px!important;width:8px!important;height:8px!important;border-right:2px solid #fff!important;border-bottom:2px solid #fff!important;transform:rotate(-45deg)!important}
#faq-8[open] #faq-8-chev,#faq-9[open] #faq-9-chev,#faq-10[open] #faq-10-chev,#faq-11[open] #faq-11-chev{transform:rotate(90deg)!important}
#faq-8-body,#faq-9-body,#faq-10-body,#faq-11-body,.oh-faq-body{padding:12px 40px 0 0!important}
#faq-8-body p,#faq-9-body p,#faq-10-body p,#faq-11-body p,.oh-faq-body p{margin:0!important;font-size:1rem!important;line-height:1.65!important;color:rgba(255,255,255,.76)!important}
/* DashDark-style 4-col footer */
#footer,#footer-new{padding:4rem 1.5rem 2.25rem!important;background:#080F25!important;color:rgba(232,236,245,.72)!important;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07)!important}
#footer-inner,#footer-inner-new{max-width:1120px!important;margin:0 auto!important}
#footer-grid,#footer-grid-new{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1.35fr repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:2.25rem 2rem!important;margin-bottom:2rem!important;align-items:start!important}
#footer-brand{display:none!important}
#footer-h-company,#footer-h-products,#footer-h-resources,#footer-h-links{margin:0 0 1rem!important;font-size:1.05rem!important;font-weight:700!important;letter-spacing:-.01em!important;color:#fff!important;text-transform:none!important}
#footer-blurb{margin:0 0 1.5rem!important;max-width:22rem!important;font-size:.95rem!important;line-height:1.65!important;color:rgba(232,236,245,.62)!important}
#footer-social-label{margin:0 0 .85rem!important;font-size:1.05rem!important;font-weight:700!important;color:#fff!important}
#footer-social{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;gap:.65rem!important;align-items:center!important}
#footer-social a{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;width:2.35rem!important;height:2.35rem!important;border-radius:999px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)!important;color:rgba(232,236,245,.78)!important;text-decoration:none!important;font-size:.85rem!important;font-weight:600!important;line-height:1!important}
#footer-social a:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2)!important}
#footer-col-products a,#footer-col-resources a,#footer-col-links a{display:block!important;margin:0 0 .7rem!important;font-size:.95rem!important;line-height:1.4!important;color:rgba(232,236,245,.62)!important;text-decoration:none!important}
#footer-col-products a:hover,#footer-col-resources a:hover,#footer-col-links a:hover{color:#fff!important}
